test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

I have been on this project since the first day, hence I am responsible ______ it.
solution:
The correct answer is "for."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• The preposition** "for" **is used in the blank to correctly indicate the responsibility or accountability associated with the project. 
 
• In this context,** "responsible for"** is a standard collocation that is commonly used to express ownership or duty regarding a particular task or project.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *I have been on this project since the first day, hence I am responsible **for**__ it.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• To: **Used to indicate direction, destination, or purpose.

 
 
• **Example**: She is going to the store.
 
• **Example**: This letter is addressed to John.
 
• **Example**: I gave the book to my friend.
 
 
 
• **From: **Indicates the point of origin or starting point.
 
 
• **Example**: I received a gift from my parents.
 
• **Example**: The train is coming from London.
 
• **Example**: The email is from my colleague.
 
 
 
• **By: **Used to indicate the method, means, or agent of doing something.
 
 
• **Example**: The report was written by the team.
